initiative.title: The Lab pays for inference with Lightning (x402 over Spark)
initiative.body: Open `POST /api/v1/inference` beyond admin keys: any Nostr key buys credit over Lightning with x402, received by a server Spark wallet, and spends it on the Lab's inference. Coax and the C API hold our logic; the Breez Spark SDK is the wallet engine behind a narrow boundary.

milestones.title: Credit over Lightning for our inference route
milestones.body: Spark receiver profile, credit ledger, top-up and draw-down routes, the Lab's payment, a live smoke.

tasks.title: The Spark receiver profile in NIP-X402, and the invariant
tasks.body: Add `openagents:spark-receiver:1` to `nips/openagents/NIP-X402.md`: settlement is proved by the receiver's own Spark wallet record of that exact invoice paid, plus the preimage hashing to its payment hash; the request binding (invoice to request digest) lives in the server's database, issued only by us, because Spark's shared SSP node signs every invoice and `receivePayment` takes a memo, not a description hash. State the trust: SSP and operators, small balances, sweep policy. Fix the stale claim that Rust `crates/x402` implements the NIP (deleted in 0b401561a0). Add the policy to INVARIANTS.md.
acceptance: NIP-X402 names the Spark receiver profile and no longer claims crates/x402
INVARIANTS.md has the Spark receiver rule and names its tests

tasks.title: The x402 v2 HTTP wire codec in Coax
tasks.body: `coax/lib/x402/x402.coax`: base64 JSON for the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` and `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` headers; read a PaymentRequired (scheme exact, network lnbtc mainnet, msat amount string, extra.invoice, extra.paymentHash, the profile), build a PaymentPayload for a retry, read a settlement response. Refuse other versions, schemes, networks and non-decimal amounts. The Lab uses it.

tasks.title: A server Spark wallet that issues invoices and reports payments
tasks.body: A narrow wallet process (Breez Spark SDK, mainnet, conversions off) on Cloud Run next to oa-api: create a BOLT11 invoice with a memo, say whether that exact invoice was paid with its payment hash and preimage, and give the BTC/USD rate. IAM-only ingress from the API's service account. A new seed in Secret Manager, never printed or committed.
acceptance: The service answers /health on Cloud Run and creates a mainnet invoice for the API
The seed exists only in Secret Manager

tasks.title: Credit balances, top-ups, used payments and a BTC price cache
tasks.body: A migration for `inference.credit` (msat per pubkey), `inference.topups` (invoice bound to the request digest), `inference.used_payments` (replay key `network:payment_hash`, inserted once) and the cached BTC/USD price, with settle and debit functions that run in one transaction.

tasks.title: POST /api/v1/inference/credit: buy credit with x402 over Spark
tasks.body: Body `{pubkey, msat}`, no NIP-98. Without proof: 402 with `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` and a Spark invoice bound to the body, within min and max top-up bounds. With `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`: the wallet's record of that invoice paid and a preimage that hashes to its payment hash, then the payment inserted once and the balance credited in one transaction; a repeat is `duplicate_settlement`.

tasks.title: The inference route admits any key with credit and debits it
tasks.body: Any NIP-98 signed key with credit above zero may use `/api/v1/inference`; admins and the allowlist still do. After metering, debit msat at the cached BTC/USD price; with no fresh price, refuse paid use (fail safe). No credit is a 402 pointing at `/api/v1/inference/credit`. The daily caps stay.

tasks.title: The Lab adds credit when our route answers 402
tasks.body: On a 402 from our route the Lab shows "Add credit: N sats" with the invoice as copyable text, then retries the top-up with the proof until it is paid or the invoice expires, and says when the credit is in. Lab only.

tasks.title: Live smoke: a real top-up and a non-admin paid request
tasks.body: Deploy the wallet and the API (staging, then production). Top up a fresh non-admin key with a few sats over Lightning, then make a signed request with it that succeeds and debits its credit. Tests never move the owner's money: without a funded throwaway payer, stop at the invoice and put the payment in NEEDS_OWNER.md.
acceptance: A paid top-up credits a non-admin key in production and its next request is debited
